title: Album screen: the big wordmark, the section title, a picture with a yellow (or grey) side band and its vertical wide label, the pager capsule and the caption
use: A gameplay or feature section; side=right with band=grey is the mirrored companion screen (the band moves left, the title right, no wordmark).

side.note: band side; right mirrors the album

wordmark.note: the wordmark row above (off pulls the album up)

mark_latin.note: Latin caps and digits: the game's wordmark

desc.default: 勘察晨昏带，立起界桩，把导线一段段延伸到地图之外。

relations: Picture 1109 x 653 plus a 229-unit band on the far side; a 27-unit white rule and the vertical label on the band.
Pager capsule on the picture's bottom-left corner; caption 40 units under the album on the picture's left edge.
decoration: The datum mark, the decoration group, the pager buttons, the grey icon tile: drawn.

provenance.corpus: traverse case (远垦导线 TRAVERSE): our own original one-page game site and two in-game screens in the frontier-survey grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/frontier-survey/style.json provenance (reference site measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: The case's gameplay and workline sections (site/index.html #gameplay, #workline) as one parametric screen; numbers from the reference's DOM.
measured: Reference: GameplayAlbum 1338 x 653 = 1109 picture + 228 band (#FFFA00, or #EDEDED mirrored), band title 54 px wide face vertical, line 27 x 618 white, pagination 164 x 63 r 31.5 with 56 px buttons.
Case: the wide label is about 1.0 em per capital in Michroma (measured), so the band label is budgeted at 10 characters.
